quotes.text: F. Scott Dueser, Abilene, Texas, has served as a director of the Company since 1991. He is Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of the Company, the Bank, and the Trust Company. He serves as chairman of the Executive Committee. He is also a director of the Bank, serving on the asset-liability management committee, the Trust Company, and Technology Company. He became CEO/President in 2001 and Chairman in 2008. Prior to his role at the Company, he was CEO/President of the Bank from 1991 to 2001 and assumed these roles again as well as Chairman of the Board effective December 30, 2012. He is a graduate of Texas Tech University with finance and accounting degrees and served on the Board of Regents of Texas Tech University from 2005 to 2009, the last two years as Chairman. He currently serves on the board of Breck Minerals LP, which is a privately held oil and gas company.
